subject: Action plan alignment and timeline for AlphaHealth evaluation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@alphahealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Action plan — alignment & timeline for AlphaHealth eval

Hi Priya —

Great to meet you last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan so we can align on success criteria, milestones, and who owns what during the evaluation. High-level goal from our side: validate Redwood Inference can meet AlphaHealth's latency/SLA targets on representative clinical workloads and demonstrate cost estimates for production scale. From your side: confirm champion sign-off and procurement/legal alignment.

Proposed evaluation scope and timeline (8 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, access checklist, commercial guardrails
- Weeks 1–2: dataset validation & initial integration (inference endpoints + KV cache)
- Weeks 3–4: tuning and quantization experiment, quality checks on 3 prompt families
- Weeks 5–6: scale test and latency SLO verification; cost modeling
- Week 7: executive review + open items
- Week 8: decision / PO or next steps

Attached is a short MAP draft you can review: AlphaHealth_MAP_v1.docx — it lists milestones, owners, and required artifacts (SRE contact, data access, test prompts). Can you confirm:
1) That this timeline looks reasonable for AlphaHealth?
2) Who will be the internal champion for sign-off?
3) Any mandatory approvals (procurement, legal) we should include now?

I can offer two kickoff slots next week: Wed 1/13 10am PST or Thu 1/14 11am PST — happy to add a calendar invite once you pick the best time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: AlphaHealth_MAP_v1.docx (docx, 82KB)

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@alphahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Action plan — alignment & timeline for AlphaHealth eval

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear plan. The 8-week cadence makes sense. I'll be the project champion on the product side, but please add our procurement lead (procurement@alphahealth.com) and Tom (copied) from procurement/legal — they will need SOC 2 evidence, retention policy, and a cost breakdown for contracting.

Two quick asks before kickoff:
- Can you include a one-page summary of the cost model (est. token cost at scale + any reserved capacity pricing)?
- Please attach our procurement questionnaire — Tom will fill it and return.

Wed 1/13 at 10am PST works for me. Please send an invite.

—Priya

Head of Product, AlphaHealth

Hi Priya / Jordan —

Thanks — glad we have a slot. Brief intro from my side: I'm Hannah (Solutions Lead, Redwood); I'll coordinate the technical onboarding, own the MAP checklist, and be the internal point for any architecture/permissions questions. Vivek (cc'd) will be the engineering lead for performance testing and will coordinate the quantization experiments. Marissa (cc'd) will own the success criteria and post-eval handoff.

To make the kickoff productive, I've attached an outline with suggested owners and artifacts: alphahealth-map-outline.xlsx. Quick additions to Jordan's timeline above:
- Pre-kickoff (prior to 1/13): set up admin accounts, exchange test dataset subset, and sign off on any IP/PHI constraints for the evaluation data.
- Week 2 deliverable: integration checklist + first 1k prompt pass rate report.
- Week 6 requirement: load test report with 99th percentile latency by model variant.

Priya — can you confirm who on your side will own data access and whether the test data needs de-identification prior to sharing? Also confirm procurement will be in the loop (Tom) so we can surface cost items up front.

I created a shared MAP doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/alphahealth-map-shared — feel free to comment directly; I'll update owners after kickoff.

Thanks — I'll send a calendar invite for Wed 1/13 10am PST and include a short agenda (20m tactical + 10m exec alignment).

Best,
